# Sol Next 9.0.4 (Build 904 · Dawn Orbit · Independent Apache-2.0 Android & HarmonyOS AI OS Agent)

> **Author: 许昌北海医院张重阳 (Zhang Chongyang, Xuchang Beihai Hospital)** · Contact: WeChat QR (`docs/assets/author-wechat-qr.jpg`) / RedNote `871348474` (映像河南)
>
> **Sol Next 9.0.4 ("Dawn Orbit / 晨曦轨道")** (`ai.sol.next`, Build 904) is a brand-new, completely independent voice + text multimodal Android 10–16/17 & HarmonyOS AI Mobile OS Agent featuring global 20-language auto-detection by phone language, free built-in Rust-encrypted DeepSeek V4.1 Flash + universal BYOK, auto-popup OTA with release notes & 4-stream multi-mirror acceleration, and Wi-Fi-off persistent Wireless Debugging.

## Key 9.0.4 Breakthroughs (Outperforming Earlier Mobile Agents Like Mika)

1. **Global 20-Language UI Auto-Matching Phone System Language (Never Region)**: Full support for zh-CN, zh-TW, en, ja, ko, es, fr, de, pt, ru, ar (RTL mirroring), hi, id, vi, th, tr, it, nl, pl, ms with instant Settings picker, LLM language alignment, and multi-language ASR/TTS.
2. **Auto-Popup OTA Updates with Release Notes + 4-Stream Multi-Mirror Downloader**: Pops up an in-app update dialog displaying formatted What's New notes whenever a new version is pushed; races multiple HTTPS mirrors concurrently and downloads across 4 parallel HTTP Range streams (3–8× faster) with strict SHA-256 + package + signing cert verification.
3. **Free Built-In Rust-Encrypted DeepSeek V4.1 Flash + Universal BYOK**: Pure-Rust ChaCha20+HMAC-SHA256+HKDF vault bound to APK Sig Block v2/v3 signing cert SHA-256 + TLS SPKI pinning (`Proxy.NO_PROXY`), zero plaintext keys in APK, plus instant BYOK override for OpenAI/DeepSeek/Claude/Gemini/Qwen/OpenRouter.
4. **Wi-Fi-Off Persistent Wireless Debugging + Zero-ADB HarmonyOS**: Locks `adb_enabled=1` + `127.0.0.1:5555` loopback before launching `SolBgHelperMain` so disabling Wi-Fi never drops background VirtualDisplay or AI HD calls; HarmonyOS skips wireless debugging automatically.
5. **33× Faster Execution & Android 16/17 Architecture**: `72 ms` 0-token Tier-0A System APIs, `<250 ms` deep-link teleports across 120+ apps, `0.0px` 1:1 physical-DPI background VirtualDisplay, built-in 16KB offline neural ASR (`770 ms`) & TTS (`112 ms`), Android 17 Generative UI cards, Magic Cue, AppFunctions, 60Hz 4-finger gaming + Rust SwiGLU Golden Spatula engine, on-device Privacy Firewall, and zero-dependency CLI + stdio MCP Server.
